Graduates work in construction, infrastructure, consultancy and public works, or continue to a master's specialisation.

universities.name: Thiagarajar College of Engineering
universities.summary: Thiagarajar College of Engineering (TCE) is a government-aided autonomous engineering college founded in 1957 at Thiruparankundram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, and affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. AICTE's 2026-27 approval covers twelve B.E. and B.Tech programmes. Indian applicants enter through TNEA counselling; AICTE records no NRI or international-student approval.
universities.campusLifestyle: TCE is at Thiruparankundram, Madurai 625015, about 8 km from Madurai railway station. Its mandatory disclosure lists classrooms, laboratories, a computer centre, library, seminar halls, a cafeteria, indoor and outdoor sports, a gymnasium and facilities for disabled students. Research units include the T S Srinivasan Centre for Automotive Research, set up with TVS Motors, and the Thiagarajar Advanced Research Centre. Student bodies run cultural, sports, literary and technical activities.
universities.cityProfile: Thiagarajar College of Engineering stands at Thiruparankundram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, postal code 625015. TNEA 2026 gives Madurai as the nearest railway station, 8 km away, and the district headquarters 12 km away. It is a different institution from Thiagarajar College, the arts and science college at Madurai, so use tce.edu and TNEA college code 5008 when you search admissions and fees. Plan housing and daily travel around this campus; college transport is listed with annual charges of INR 33,000 to 46,900.
universities.practicalExposure: TCE has used the CDIO framework, Conceive, Design, Implement and Operate, for curriculum design, teaching and assessment since 2018. TVS Motors subject experts helped shape the Mechanical and Electrical Engineering curricula, and the college runs the T S Srinivasan Centre for Automotive Research with TVS Motors. As an autonomous college it designs its own curriculum and examinations while remaining affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student. TNEA 2026 prints a placement figure of 89 per cent for TCE without a year or method, so treat it as indicative; no placement is guaranteed.
universities.hostelOverview: TCE has permanent men's and women's hostels, each with a warden and deputy wardens; the women's hostel admits subject to availability. TNEA 2026 lists room rent of INR 3,750 a year for boys and INR 3,250 for girls, mess INR 3,200 a year, electricity INR 500 a year and a caution deposit of INR 7,500. Hostel pages publish general, maintenance, discipline and mess documents. Confirm the current charges and your allocation with the hostel office before relying on a room.
universities.dietarySupport: TNEA 2026 lists the TCE hostel mess as vegetarian for both boys and girls, with a printed mess bill of INR 3,200 a year. Menus, special-diet provision and allergy handling are not published, so ask the hostel warden about individual requirements before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: TCE runs a grievance redressal committee for students, staff and faculty chaired by the Principal, and its AICTE mandatory disclosure lists medical facilities and student insurance. TNEA 2026 publishes an anti-ragging helpline for the college (+91 94426 17770). Confirm hostel entry rules and night-time emergency arrangements with the warden.
universities.studentSupport: The counselling division works from the campus health centre with a tutor-ward system and tele-counselling, and trains counsellors with the Chella Muthu Trust Research Foundation. The college also lists career counselling. Students Traffic counselling can help you plan TNEA choices for TCE.

faq.question: Is Thiagarajar College of Engineering the same as Thiagarajar College, Madurai?
faq.answer: No. Thiagarajar College of Engineering (tce.edu) is the engineering, architecture and planning college at Thiruparankundram. Thiagarajar College (tcarts.in) is a separate arts and science college, so do not reuse that college's admissions or fees.

faq.question: Is Thiagarajar College of Engineering autonomous?
faq.answer: Yes. UGC's autonomous-colleges list shows Thiagarajar College of Engg., Madurai, affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, autonomous since 1987-88 with the current period running 2022-23 to 2031-32. TNEA 2026 also lists its autonomous status as Yes.

faq.question: Is Thiagarajar College of Engineering a government or private college?
faq.answer: It is government-aided and privately managed. AICTE records it as Govt aided, run by the Kalaithanthai Karumuttu Thiagaraja Chettiar Memorial Charitable Trust. Aid does not make it a government-owned college.

faq.question: Is Thiagarajar College of Engineering AICTE approved?
faq.answer: Yes. AICTE's Extension of Approval for 2026-27, dated 11 May 2026 under permanent ID 1-429823423, covers twelve B.E./B.Tech programmes at TCE. Electrical and Computer Engineering, Fashion Technology and VLSI Design and Technology are approved as new courses.

faq.question: How do I get admission to B.E. or B.Tech at Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faq.answer: Admission is through Tamil Nadu's TNEA counselling: register on the TNEA portal, get a rank from Class 12 Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry marks, and choose TCE's college code 5008 with a branch code. TCE reports a single-window route and no separate entrance test.

faq.question: What marks do I need to apply to Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faq.answer: TNEA 2026 asks for a pass in both higher-secondary years with an average of at least 45 per cent in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry for the general category, or 40 per cent for BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA and ST. The vocational stream has separate subject rules.

faq.question: Can international or NRI students join Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faq.answer: AICTE's 2026-27 approval marks NRI and international-student approval as No for every course. TNEA permits only Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO card holders, excluding those born abroad after 4 March 2021, and eligible Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: What is the fee at Thiagarajar College of Engineering?
faq.answer: TCE does not publish programme-wise tuition and TNEA 2026 prints none, so tuition is on request. TNEA 2026 lists an admission fee of INR 4,000, establishment charges of INR 29,000 and a caution deposit of INR 7,500. Confirm the fee for your seat category with the college.

faq.question: Which programmes does Thiagarajar College of Engineering offer through TNEA?
faq.answer: AICTE approves Civil, Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Science and Business Systems, AI and Machine Learning, Electrical and Computer, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, VLSI Design and Technology, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Information Technology and Fashion Technology for 2026-27.

faq.question: Does Thiagarajar College of Engineering have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes. TCE has permanent men's and women's hostels with a vegetarian mess. TNEA 2026 lists room rent of INR 3,750 a year for boys and INR 3,250 for girls, mess INR 3,200 a year and a INR 7,500 caution deposit. The women's hostel admits subject to availability.

faq.question: Does Thiagarajar College of Engineering offer postgraduate and design programmes?
faq.answer: Yes, its programme directory also lists B.Arch., B.Des. Interior Design, an integrated M.Sc. Data Science, five M.E. routes, MCA and M.Plan. This page covers the twelve B.E./B.Tech programmes; ask Students Traffic about the others.

eligibility.intro: TNEA 2026 sets these conditions for the academic stream; the separate vocational stream has its own subject rules.
items: A pass in both higher-secondary years (Class 11 and 12) or an equivalent examination

BC/BCM, MBC/DNC and SC/SCA/ST: at least 40 per cent average in those three subjects
TNEA nativity: Tamil Nadu schooling for Classes 8 to 12, a Tamil Nadu nativity certificate or another listed category

applicationSteps: Register one online application on the TNEA portal and enter academic, school, identity and category details
Upload Class 10 to 12 certificates and any community, nativity or other category documents for verification
Fill and lock choices in your counselling round, entering TCE's college code 5008 with the branch code, then accept the allotment
Report to TCE with the allotment order and pay the fees notified for your seat category
